questions.question: Pointing to the photograph of Amit, Gagan, said, 'His sister's mother's husband is my daughter's mother's husband's father. 'How is Amit related to Gagan?
questions.solution:
Given,

Pointing to the photograph of Amit, Gagan, said, 'His sister's mother's husband is my daughter's mother's husband's father.

The family tree is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ca9c3b5e77f1fdcb65c1a9d98983431f188cdfa2efda6f37dc5b848a730bd9e.png] 

Here we see Amit is the **brother** of Gagan.

**Hence, the correct answer is Brother.**

questions.question: If A is the brother of B, C is the father of D, F is the daughter of E, L is the brother of D's father, B is the sister of L and E is the wife of C, then how is F related to A?
questions.solution:
The Family tree chart for the given data is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9e0b1b51a4b88f1f42bd622587ace2855c2f932ada76b29fdfe9866858d9934.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56ce63898180bfd0d2146a8f1a0abb2e82fe42b6a53656dcdddebfb1c784e69a.png] 

Clearly, **F is the niece of A.**

questions.question: Manisha's sister Sakshi is the wife of Subham. Subham is the brother of Darshan. Akash, the son of Manisha, has a sister Rekha who is the daughter of Darshan. Rekha's father Darshan’s mother is Saloni. How is Saloni related to Sakshi?
questions.solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b02115387156e02316bfb1dd95fcf89921e131b2ebba984f145a37f06b22e5d9.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38f75362b6e1f8ce42204233fdf85b5af1e34669f6c901f0a019aeb751b53afd.png] 

Clearly, Saloni is mother-in-law of Sakshi.

Hence, ‘**Mother-in-law**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Introducing a girl a boy says, “She is the only daughter of the wife of my brother-in-law”. How is the girl related to the boy?
questions.solution:
Table showing the different symbols used to represent the relation and generation change.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85ed53056a8b4cdd10af896cb37597826b982db89516c50067de54f1666ac010.png] 

She is the only daughter of the wife of my brother-in-law → Wife of the person’s brother-in-law is the sister of the person itself. The daughter of the person’s sister is the ‘**niece’** of the person.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7bc18726a9f7e4b8ca4b1ed601d71522e5e89e1e1066239095652b400301f5d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **‘niece’.**

questions.question: Pointing to a man, Radhika said - "His son's mother is the sister of my son's sister." How is the person related to Radhika?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87a56de162e9b334490db7733674e7aef59028f5f8143051317e0f129848f304.png] ​

Given that,

 
• Radhika points at a man and says that his son's mother is the sister of Radhika's son's sister. 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b669cd2dae1896e1793ef2daee765d5fb00b47ca7e038e36bd442e4470b0a30.png] 

Now, Radhika has 3 children, out of which 2 are daughters and 1 is a son. Now, one of the daughters is married and has a son. The man happens to be The married daughter's husband. Thus, the man is her son in law.

Thus, option 3 is correct.

questions.question: Pointing to the photograph of a boy, Vikas said, ”His father’s mother, Sunitha, is my wife’s sister’s mother”. How is Sunitha related to Vikas ?
questions.solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/157d2ec770237097989beb9a00ef41711bba34c2aea64333d8b7821f025c749e.png] 

Vikas's wife's sister's mother is Sunita means Sunita is the mother of Vikas's wife

So, Sunita is the mother in law of Vikas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d00d9ff04e2a091a0fd1978b222e04d4a193ed970911adacc405d8abd5c3de76.png] 

Hence, 'Mother in law' is the correct answer.
